title: Desk Guidance: Patient Payment Plan Down Payment Due at Signing
content:
**Calculation.** The down payment due when a patient signs a **Patient Payment Plan** agreement is the signing share — the tier's down payment percentage — of the signing balance, which is the enrolled total, rounded half-up to the cent.

**Order of assembly.** The figure due at signing is assembled in this order: the signing share of the signing balance is taken first, a percentage held back is taken off it next and the part left is rounded half-up to the cent, an amount credited is taken away after that with the figure never falling below zero, and amounts added to it come last.

### Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

| Enrolled total | Tier down payment percentage | Down payment due at signing |
|---|---|---|
| 5000.00 | 10 percent | 500.00 |
| 2345.67 | 10 percent | 234.567 rounded half-up, 234.57 |
| 1800.00 | 0 percent | 0.00 |
